verdict: Paid ads are paused; 38 leads this period arrived before the stop.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 38 leads at $11.11 per lead across $422 in Meta spend — all of that activity came before September 17, when paid campaigns went to zero and have remained there for 11 consecutive days. With no paid spend running, organic channels are beginning to soften: Google Business Profile actions are down roughly 28% week over week and search clicks are down 36%, consistent with the loss of the paid halo effect. Of the 44 opportunities created in your pipeline this period, none have been logged as won or converted to appointments, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up — not a problem with the ads themselves. Reactivating campaigns and tightening the intake process are the immediate priorities heading into the next period.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta before campaigns paused
actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: Meta campaigns have been paused for 11 days, and 44 pipeline opportunities show zero appointments or closed leads, pointing to a lead follow-up gap.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated and the intake process is being reviewed to ensure leads that arrive are being reached and converted.
